title: Production incident: memory leak in data processing service caused by AI agent
snippet: Week 4 opened with a production incident, a memory leak in a data processing service that was causing OOM kills under sustained load. AI-generated code from Cursor/Claude comparison.

title: Claude went crazy on parallel agents and burned entire session in 5 minutes
snippet: User report: 'Claude went crazy on parallel agents and I burned an entire session in under 5 minutes.' Highlights need for cost/concurrency circuit breakers.

title: Pain Point: How to stop or rollback AI agent mid-execution?
snippet: Discussion about the lack of reliable 'kill switches' or rollback mechanisms for agents with file system/DB access.

title: Show HN: Agent Package Manager (APM) by Microsoft/GitHub
snippet: CLI to manage AI agent dependencies with lock files and supply-chain audits (apm audit). Validation of the 'Control Layer' market.

title: Show HN: G0 – The control layer for AI agents (scan, test, monitor, comply)
snippet: Static/behavioral analysis, red teaming, and runtime monitoring for agents. Specifically includes OpenClaw/ClawSec support.

title: Cursor used for 150 million lines of enterprise code daily
snippet: Massive scale of AI code generation (150M lines/day) highlights the critical need for automated governance at the deploy gate.
